description:
We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Licensed Nursing Home Administrator (LNHA) to lead operations at a premier skilled nursing facility in Baltimore County, MD. This is an exceptional opportunity for a visionary leader to make a significant impact on resident care and facility success.

As the LNHA, you will be responsible for overseeing all aspects of facility management, ensuring compliance with regulatory standards, and fostering a positive environment for both residents and staff. Join a team committed to delivering high-quality care and achieving operational excellence.
requirements: Active and unencumbered Licensed Nursing Home Administrator (LNHA) license in Maryland.
Minimum of 3-5 years of experience in a leadership role within a skilled nursing or long-term care facility.
Comprehensive knowledge of state and federal regulations governing skilled nursing facilities.
Demonstrated ability to manage financial, operational, and clinical aspects of a healthcare facility.
Strong leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills.
salaryOrBonusInfo: Competitive salary ranging from $115,000 to $145,000 annually, based on experience and qualifications.

description:
We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Assistant Director of Nursing (ADON) to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Frostburg, MD. This vital leadership role offers a competitive salary ranging from $75,000 to $90,000 per year, providing an excellent opportunity for a skilled nursing professional to advance their career.

The Assistant Director of Nursing will play a crucial role in supporting the Director of Nursing, overseeing daily nursing operations, and ensuring the highest standards of patient care. This position is ideal for a compassionate leader who is committed to fostering a positive environment for both residents and staff. While an RN is preferred, we encourage all qualified candidates to apply.
requirements: Current RN license in the state of Maryland
Previous experience in a leadership role within a skilled nursing or rehabilitation setting
Strong clinical assessment and critical thinking skills
Knowledge of state and federal regulations governing long-term care
salaryOrBonusInfo: Compensation ranges from $75,000 to $90,000 annually, based on experience and qualifications.

description: We are urgently seeking a dedicated and compassionate Physical Therapist Assistant (PTA) to join our team in Helena, AL. This PRN role offers the flexibility to provide essential therapy services on a per-visit basis, supporting patients in their recovery and rehabilitation journey within a community setting. We are looking for a professional who is ready to make an immediate impact. This is an urgent need, and we are looking to fill this position quickly. Join a team committed to patient-centered care and professional growth. This role offers competitive per-visit compensation, allowing you to manage your schedule while making a significant difference in patients' lives.
requirements: Associate's degree from an accredited Physical Therapist Assistant (PTA) program
Current and valid Alabama PTA licensure
Prior experience in home health or community-based therapy preferred
